title: Gracious God
story:
A man once got trapped in a deep forest while returning home.

Night fell quickly.

He had no clear path.

He started to panic.

He called out for help, even though no one seemed nearby.

After some time, a forest ranger found him.

The man asked,

“How did you find me in such a huge forest?”

The ranger replied,

“I was listening for anyone who called for help.”

“You didn’t have to find the way alone.”

“I was already looking for you.”

The man felt relieved and safe.

In life, we often feel overwhelmed.

We think no one hears us.

No one cares.

No one will respond.

But God is different.

He is gracious.

He is righteous.

He is full of compassion.

When we call on Him, He hears.

And He responds with mercy.
life_lesson: God is gracious, righteous, and full of compassion toward those who call on Him.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your mercy and compassion.

Thank You for hearing me when I call out to You.

When I feel lost or alone, remind me that You are near.

Help me to trust in Your goodness.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you believe God hears you when you call out to Him?

How does His compassion give you comfort today?

What situation do you need to bring to Him right now?
verse:
The Lord is gracious and righteous;
our God is full of compassion.
